questions.example: Can you give us a 5% discount for a large order?
questions.exampleZh: 大量訂購的話，可以給我們 5% 的折扣嗎？

questions.example: The goods will arrive at our warehouse on Monday.
questions.exampleZh: 這批貨星期一會送到我們的倉庫。

questions.example: Could you send me the tracking number for this order?
questions.exampleZh: 可以給我這筆訂單的追蹤號碼嗎？

questions.example: Please check the specification before you place the order.

questions.prompt: Some boxes were ____ during shipping, so we need a replacement.
questions.example: Some boxes were damaged during shipping, so we need a replacement.
questions.exampleZh: 有幾箱在運送途中損壞了，所以我們需要換貨。

questions.prompt: My manager needs to ____ the quotation first.
questions.example: My manager needs to approve the quotation first. I will reply tomorrow.
questions.exampleZh: 我的主管需要先核准報價單，我明天回覆你。

questions.prompt: Is this item ____ now, or do we need to wait?
questions.example: Is this item available now, or do we need to wait two weeks?
questions.exampleZh: 這個品項現在有貨嗎？還是我們要等兩週？

questions.prompt: 情境：Email 裡要說「附件是更新後的訂單」，最自然的說法是？
options: Please find attached the updated order.
I attaching the order for you.
The order is attach in email.
questions.example: Hi Lisa, please find attached the updated purchase order.
questions.exampleZh: Lisa 你好，附件是更新後的採購單。

questions.prompt: 情境：想約廠商開個電話會議討論交期，最自然的說法是？
options: Can we schedule a call to discuss the lead time?
We call when? Talk lead time.
Can we schedule call for discuss?
questions.example: Can we schedule a call this week to discuss the lead time?
questions.exampleZh: 我們這週可以約個電話討論交期嗎？

questions.prompt: 情境：廠商很快回信，你想先道謝，最自然的說法是？
questions.example: Thanks for your quick reply. The new price looks good to us.
questions.exampleZh: 謝謝你這麼快回覆，新的價格我們覺得可以。
